title: SSE stream terminates on multi-byte UTF-8 split across chunks
description: subscribe_events calls str::from_utf8(&bytes) on each raw reqwest chunk (client.rs ~line 357). A valid UTF-8 multi-byte sequence (e.g. 3-byte code point) split across two adjacent transport chunks causes str::from_utf8 to return Err on the first chunk, which immediately returns ClientError::Parse and terminates the stream (state=None). The stream is killed by valid data that arrived in two pieces. Correct fix: accumulate raw bytes until a valid UTF-8 boundary, then decode.
